function red_centerpics, ims, _ref_extra = extra dims = size(ims, /dim) Nframes = dims[2] cim = red_centerpic(ims[*, *, 0], _extra = extra) cdim = size(cim, /dim) cims = fltarr([cdim, Nframes]) cims[*, *, 0] = cim for iframe = 1, Nframes-1 do cims[*, *, iframe] = red_centerpic(ims[*, *, iframe], _extra = extra) return, cims end
